spec.description: What Home-IDS decides and learns on its own: the false-positive filter, autotuning (global, per type, per device), learned trust, baselines, LLM review, retro-hunting.

options.content: Can you trust what it does while you're not watching? Top to bottom: the **false-positive filter**, **autotuning** (global, per device type, per device), **what it has learned**, and its **background jobs**.
Every alert candidate passes through this filter before it can reach you.

spec.title: Filter funnel (per hour)
spec.description: Candidates checked, how many were hard-stopped (strong evidence, never suppressible), and how many were hidden as false positives.

spec.title: Which stage decided (per hour)
spec.description: TRUST_CACHE = already-trusted destination. STAGE_1_HARD_STOP = strong evidence. STAGE_1B_LOCAL_ORIGIN = your own device. STAGE_3_COMBINED = the ML + similarity score.

spec.title: Learned trust by destination kind
spec.description: Trust entries the filter has learned (mean trust in the next panel).

spec.title: Mean learned trust by destination kind
spec.description: 0-100%: how strongly each kind of destination is trusted.

spec.title: Filter models
spec.description: Are the filter's classifier (LightGBM) and similarity (embedding) models loaded? Without them it falls back to simpler rules: more alerts, not fewer.

options.content: Autotune proposes a value, tests it in a canary period, backtests it, then promotes or rolls back. A device uses its own value if it has one, else its device type's, else the global value.

spec.title: Global values
spec.description: Network-wide calibrated values against their configured defaults.

properties.value: Proposed, still in its canary period.

spec.title: Per device type
spec.description: Values calibrated for a whole device type.

properties.value: In force for this device type.
Proposed, still in its canary period.

spec.title: Per device
spec.description: Values calibrated for one specific device (filter with the device box).

spec.expr: max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(home_ids_autotune_value{scope="device"}, "device", "$1", "target", "(.*)")) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}) * 0 + 1), "key", " · ", "hostname", "parameter"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(home_ids_autotune_canary_value{scope="device"}, "device", "$1", "target", "(.*)")) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}) * 0 + 1), "key", " · ", "hostname", "parameter"))

properties.value: Proposed, still in its canary period.

spec.title: Autotune history
spec.description: Every change autotune has made, by threshold, scope and outcome. Promoted = active; superseded = replaced later; rolled back = undone (for example by the circuit breaker after a missed threat); not promoted = its trial ended without promotion.

spec.title: Last promotion
spec.description: When autotune last promoted a new value.

spec.title: Last rollback
spec.description: When a value was last rolled back (for example by the circuit breaker after a missed threat).

spec.title: Last backtest
spec.description: Did the most recent backtest (which gates every promotion) pass?

spec.title: Backtest age
spec.description: Time since the last backtest finished.

spec.title: Behaviour models by kind
spec.description: Per-device statistical baseline models (Gaussian, Beta, Poisson, Markov).

spec.title: Starter baselines by device type
spec.description: Population priors: new devices start from what similar devices look like, instead of from zero.

spec.title: Identity self-healing (per hour)
spec.description: A device's split identities merged back into one, or re-identified after a MAC address change.

options.content: Scheduled jobs that review the engine's own decisions. Their results come straight from the scheduler.

spec.title: LLM review: last success
spec.description: The LLM re-reviews suspicious decisions every few hours; under ~5h is normal.

spec.title: Reviewed last run
spec.description: Decisions reviewed (fresh LLM calls plus reuses of an earlier answer for the same pattern).

spec.title: Fresh LLM calls
spec.description: Real calls to the LLM in the last run (each can take minutes).

spec.title: Waiting for review
spec.description: Decisions left for the next run. They are reviewed oldest first.

spec.title: Stopped for time
spec.description: Did the last run stop early to stay inside its time budget? That's normal on a slow LLM host; the rest waits.

spec.title: Retro-hunt: last success
spec.description: Re-checks past traffic against today's threat intel, daily.

spec.title: Retro-hunt findings
spec.description: Past connections now known to be bad, found in the last run.

spec.title: Cross-device matches
spec.description: Past connections matching something another of your devices has since confirmed.

spec.title: Retro-hunt findings by device
spec.description: Per device, from the last run.

spec.expr: max by (hostname) ((home_ids_scheduler_task_result_by_device{task="live_retro_hunter", field="findings_by_device"}) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state) * 0 + 1))

max by (hostname) ((home_ids_scheduler_task_result_by_device{task="live_retro_hunter", field="local_intel_matches_by_device"}) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state) * 0 + 1))

properties.value: Matches to threats another device confirmed.
